description: A `let <x/>` declaration standing in a `<db>` body is a declaration (an item position), not E-DECL-KEYWORD-NOT-ITEM. Target: compiles clean. Today the bootstrap refuses the block-owned server-side state by name (E-BOOTSTRAP-UNSUPPORTED).
rationale: §66.2.5 Amendment (S469): "`let <x/>` / `export <x/>` (and a locked `<x/>` declaration) MAY stand directly in a `<db>` body or a `<channel>` body."
